subject: general
question: Who received the International Booker Prize in 2020 for the novel "The Discomfort of Evening"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marieke Lucas Rijneveld**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marieke Lucas Rijneveld** was announced as the winner of the **International Booker Prize** in **2020**, becoming the youngest author to receive this accolade at the age of **29**.
 
• The prize-winning novel, **The Discomfort of Evening** (originally **De avond is ongemak**), is a debut work that explores themes of grief, faith, and family dynamics within a strict **Dutch Reformed** farming community.
 
• The award recognizes fiction from around the world that has been translated into **English** and published in the **United Kingdom** or **Ireland**.
 
• In accordance with the prize rules, the **£50,000** award money was shared equally between the author and the translator, **Michele Hutchison**, to highlight the collaborative nature of translated literature.
 
• The book achieved significant critical acclaim for its visceral imagery and was a bestseller in the **Netherlands** before gaining global recognition through this win.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other notable authors associated with the prize include:
 
 
• **Olga Tokarczuk**: A **Polish** Nobel laureate who won the **International Booker Prize** in **2018** for her novel **Flights**, translated by Jennifer Croft.
 
• **Jokha Alharthi**: An author from **Oman** who made history in **2019** as the first **Arabic-language** writer to win the prize for her novel **Celestial Bodies**.
 
• **Fernanda Melchor**: A celebrated **Mexican** author whose novel **Hurricane Season** was among the six books shortlisted for the **2020** prize alongside Rijneveld.
